title: cebatha mollis
intro: Cebatha mollis, commonly known as "Bitter Apple," is a plant species from the Sapindaceae family, native to tropical regions of Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing pain and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Cebatha mollis include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of Cebatha mollis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
